name: Example successor with counted evidence
system_prompt: Read the supplied observations, weigh repeated events, and return a grade with a rationale and cited observations.

design_audit.hypothesis: Counting repeated events per category separates routine volume from a genuine anomaly in the grade decision.

detector_rulesets.justification: Holding the detector fixed isolates the effect of the new evidence tool.

tools.justification: Added a bounded per-category count so the investigator sees concentration rather than raw rows.

investigator_prompt.justification: Instructs the investigator to cite the counted observations it actually used.
